name: Libertify
fix_description: In _deposit, add reentrancy guard. External token interactions during deposit allow re-entry before share minting state is finalized.
difficulty_reasoning: This exploit requires understanding a protocol-specific reentrancy in LibertiVault.deposit via a crafted 1inch aggregation callback, then using flash-loaned liquidity and repeated deposit/exit cycles to manipulate share minting and drain value. While the PoC is not very long, it involves multi-contract interaction (Aave, vault, 1inch, Uniswap) and non-obvious callback-based control flow rather than a simple standalone bug.
